component.name: Bishop
component.summary: Terminal with a built-in AI assistant

description.p: Bishop is a terminal emulator with Claude Code built into a side panel. The assistant sees what is in your terminal and types into it the way you would, including over SSH, so it works with your own session and access instead of needing its own.

ul.li: Tabs, each with its own terminal session and assistant
Approvals before the assistant types, or an automatic mode
Warnings for destructive commands, and a guard that never types at password prompts
An Emergency Stop that halts the assistant and terminates what it started
An activity log of everything the assistant typed
Themes, a full color palette editor, background opacity and zoom

description.p: The assistant requires Claude Code, installed separately.
Tabs, each with its own assistant; packages for Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, openSUSE and Arch; and security hardening from a full audit.
